steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Xenia was the sacred code of hospitality between guest and host, protected by Zeus Xenios | Key Fact: A good host provided food, drink, a bath, rest and a gift before asking the guest's identity | Key Fact: A good guest showed respect, did not outstay their welcome and did not make excessive demands | Key Fact: The Phaeacians (King Alcinous and Queen Arete) demonstrate ideal xenia — they host Odysseus generously
